attempts.sql: WITH db_classes AS (SELECT s.symbol_id, s.file_id, s.qualname FROM code.symbols s JOIN code.class_bases cb ON cb.class_symbol_id = s.symbol_id WHERE s.kind = 'class' AND cb.base_name = 'SQLDatabase' AND NOT s.file_id LIKE '%/tests/%' AND NOT s.file_id LIKE 'tests/%'), get_cols AS (SELECT s.symbol_id, s.file_id, s.qualname, s.summary, s.summary_source FROM code.symbols s WHERE s.kind = 'function' AND s.name = 'get_columns') SELECT DISTINCT g.symbol_id FROM get_cols g JOIN db_classes c ON g.file_id = c.file_id AND g.qualname LIKE c.qualname || '.%' WHERE (g.summary IS NULL OR g.summary = '') AND (g.summary_source IS NULL OR g.summary_source <> 'docstring')

request:
Among the production database connector classes that directly subclass SQLDatabase (auto_ontology/connectors/base.py), excluding classes in test code (any file under a tests/ folder), which ones override get_columns with their own get_columns method that has no docstring of its own (a leading # comment is not a docstring)? Return the symbol ID of each such get_columns method.

Requested output columns: symbol_id (string).
explanation: Finds production classes that directly subclass SQLDatabase, then locates get_columns methods defined in the same file under those classes. It filters out methods whose summary indicates a docstring, returning the symbol IDs of overrides without their own docstring.
sql: WITH db_classes AS (SELECT s.symbol_id, s.file_id, s.qualname FROM code.symbols s JOIN code.class_bases cb ON cb.class_symbol_id = s.symbol_id WHERE s.kind = 'class' AND cb.base_name = 'SQLDatabase' AND NOT s.file_id LIKE '%/tests/%' AND NOT s.file_id LIKE 'tests/%'), get_cols AS (SELECT s.symbol_id, s.file_id, s.qualname, s.summary, s.summary_source FROM code.symbols s WHERE s.kind = 'function' AND s.name = 'get_columns') SELECT DISTINCT g.symbol_id FROM get_cols g JOIN db_classes c ON g.file_id = c.file_id AND g.qualname LIKE c.qualname || '.%' WHERE (g.summary IS NULL OR g.summary = '') AND (g.summary_source IS NULL OR g.summary_source <> 'docstring')
